title: Skills-first multi-agent collaboration workflow
heading: Relvo Agent Workflow
subtitle: Portable collaboration reference | v0.1 Draft

coordinator.label: TaskPacket + Coordinator
coordinator.note: Acceptance, dependencies, write scope. Chooses the smallest sufficient execution.

alternatives_heading: Alternative execution modes — choose one, not all

alternatives.label: Multi-agent (optional)
alternatives.note: Dependency-ready disjoint scopes. Not always faster

control_strip.label: Questions · ControlReceipt · Checkpoint
control_strip.note: Applies during execution. Persisted ≠ observed ≠ applied. Unsupported resume → blocked. History ≠ live durability.

evidence.label: Result + embedded Evidence
evidence.note: Coordinator correlation and exact target readback

dev_strip.label: Development-only, optional
dev_strip.note: Frozen candidate → PR + fresh review → human merge, separately authorized. Not universal.

skills_panel.heading: Shared skills & contracts layer
skills_panel.layer_note: Portable across tools. Distinct from provider adapters, which are wiring guides, not runtimes.
skills_panel.records_note: Bundle groups records for offline checks, not a runtime supervisor.

footer: Reference workflow, not a runtime. Provider probes: NOT RUN. Offline checks do not verify external state.
